unit.why: A short anecdote, told by the narrator's interlocutor, about the Maggid (of Kozhnitz) and the Holy Jew disputing a Torah novella. It is framed as an illustration of the preceding conversation.
unit.boundary_note: frame continues from previous division (the halakhic exchange it comments on); next division begins a new numbered item

stories.start_quote: ואח״כ מיד סיפר כי עובדא היה
stories.end_quote: גם כאן היה כדבר הזה והבן
stories.summary_en: The Maggid tells a Torah novella before the Holy Jew, who first refutes it and then sets it right; the Maggid thanks him, saying he was building worlds with that novella and the refutation would have destroyed them; the narrator sees the same thing in his own preceding exchange.
